svg.aria-label: A race condition on counter++: the increment is really load, add and store; two threads interleave so both load 41, both store 42, and one increment is lost. A lock or an atomic instruction makes the three steps indivisible.
svg.title: A race condition on counter++: the increment is really load, add and store; two threads interleave so both load 41, both store 42, and one increment is lost. A lock or an atomic instruction makes the three steps indivisible.
svg.text: With a lock or atomic op
